name: Ibzan
overview: Ibzan was a judge of Israel from Bethlehem who led the nation for seven years, as recorded in Judges 12:8-10. He is noted for having a large family, with thirty sons and thirty daughters, whom he strategically married to families outside his own to strengthen alliances. His leadership period reflects the ongoing cycle of governance and deliverance during the era of the judges, and he was ultimately buried in his hometown of Bethlehem.
